proposed_next_method.status: Design recommendation, not implemented or claimed successful
proposed_next_method.name: Geometric route selection by decision-relevant value of information
steps: Keep the existing independent MBD chains and geometric alternatives.
First select the minimum monitoring-cost trajectory using the prescribed zero performance wind.
Update POAM only from actual measured wind; compare pre-observation predictions with actual innovations.
For plausible alternative routes, consider short prefixes feasible under the current uncertain execution filter.
Value measurements by their expected reduction in subsequent route-selection loss, accounting for the monitoring cost of obtaining them. Reuse a bounded coherent wind ensemble.
Remove the learning incentive when plausible wind fields agree on the best route, including when wind cannot change the ranking.
proposed_next_method.limitation: A bounded route ensemble and finite decision look-ahead approximate the Bayes-adaptive planning problem. The same robot/wind/clarity models remain; no bandit regret or safety theorem is claimed for this robot.
proposed_next_method.compute: Reuse trajectory cost and wind prediction banks; benchmark added overhead against the 1 s total warm planning limit before a mission. No measured runtime for the unimplemented selector.
